result: Reviewed human entries read 2026-10-21. PNLIP (P16233) preferentially splits the esters of long-chain fatty acids at positions 1 and 3, producing mainly 2-monoacylglycerol and free fatty acids. CLPS (P04118) is a cofactor that anchors pancreatic lipase at the lipid-water interface; without it bile salts wash the enzyme off. MOGAT2 (Q3SYC2) transfers an acyl chain from acyl-CoA to monoacylglycerol, forming diacylglycerol. DGAT1 (O75907) catalyses the terminal and only committed step of triacylglycerol synthesis, is highly expressed in small-intestinal epithelial cells and is essential for absorption of dietary fats. MTTP (P55157) transports triglyceride, cholesteryl ester and phospholipid between phospholipid surfaces and is required for assembly and secretion of apolipoprotein B-containing lipoproteins. APOB (P04114): apo B-48 is a major protein of chylomicrons. SCD (O00767) inserts a cis double bond at the delta-9 position of fatty acyl-CoA substrates including stearoyl-CoA, using O2 and electrons from reduced cytochrome b5. FDFT1 (P37268) condenses two farnesyl diphosphates to squalene, the first committed step of sterol biosynthesis. SQLE (Q14534) oxidises squalene to (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene and is considered rate-limiting in steroid biosynthesis. COMT (P21964) catalyses catechol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = guaiacol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine; the Val158Met variant results in a 3- to 4-fold difference in activity. LCT (P09848), lactase/phlorizin hydrolase, a homodimer of the apical membrane of small-intestinal enterocytes, hydrolyses lactose to beta-D-galactose and D-glucose (EC 3.2.1.108). SLC5A1 (P13866, SGLT1) transports D-glucose or D-galactose across the apical membrane of enterocytes with 2 Na+ per sugar; basolateral exit is provided by GLUT2. SLC2A2 (P11168, GLUT2) is a facilitative transporter of glucose, fructose and galactose. GALM (Q96C23), GALK1 (P51570), GALT (P07902) and GALE (Q14376) constitute the Leloir pathway that converts beta-D-galactose to glucose 1-phosphate in the liver; GALM interconverts beta- and alpha-D-galactose, GALK1 phosphorylates alpha-D-galactose with ATP in the first committed step, GALT converts alpha-D-galactose 1-phosphate and UDP-glucose to alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate and UDP-galactose, GALE interconverts UDP-glucose and UDP-galactose. PGM1 (P36871) isomerises alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate to alpha-D-glucose 6-phosphate via glucose 1,6-bisphosphate. TRPV6 (Q9H1D0) is a calcium-selective channel that mediates Ca2+ uptake in tissues including the intestine. S100G (P29377) is calbindin-D9k, the intestinal vitamin D-dependent calcium-binding protein. ATP2B1 (P20020, PMCA1) transports calcium from the cytoplasm to the extracellular space, is located in the basolateral membrane and promotes intestinal calcium absorption.
